mutants.name: warn-appends-to-failures
mutants.why: the arm must append to warnings, never failures; appending to failures makes passed False on any earlier-step-only file, which t2 asserts is True

mutants.name: own-step-set-from-union
mutants.why: own-step set must come from THIS step's text only; using the union text makes own == union so the arm can never fire; t2 expects a warn that the silenced arm never emits

mutants.name: verdict-row-always-pass
mutants.why: the verdict row must emit WARN when warnings are present; changing WARN to PASS masks the reading; t7 asserts the WARN token

mutants.name: ledger-reason-code-always-null
mutants.why: reason_code must carry earlier-step-only paths for the census query; forcing NULL makes the ledger row unqueryable; t9 asserts the non-null value
mutants.anchor:
reason = (
                "earlier-step-only: " + ", ".join(w["evidence"] for w in scope_step_warns)
                if scope_step_warns else None
            )

mutants.name: fail-dominance-removed
mutants.why: a file the union fails must only appear in failures, never in warnings; removing the failed_set guard lets union-failed files also warn; t3 asserts warnings == []
